segments.en: May we return to you chapter “a woman is acquired.”

segments.he: הָאִישׁ מְקַדֵּשׁ בּוֹ וּבִשְׁלוּחוֹ. הָאִשָּׁה מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת בָּהּ וּבִשְׁלוּחָהּ. הָאִישׁ מְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ כְּשֶׁהִיא נַעֲרָה, בּוֹ וּבִשְׁלוּחוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A man can betroth» a woman «by himself or by» means of «his agent.» Similarly, «a woman can become betrothed by herself or by» means of «her agent. A man can betroth his daughter» to a man «when she is a young woman,» either «by himself or by» means of «his agent.»

moves.summary: Betrothal by oneself or by agent, for man, woman, and father of a naarah

positions.claim: a man or woman may effect betrothal personally or through an agent; a father may betroth his daughter when she is a naarah
